test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15712b5efc46c92c99a4fce560ab2f2d3c0e6e207959ed97e2aa367d5c51e636.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and third column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e321690cd092a333cdd1406523d6df9877460d37da084b4e460e9d71e4cc69c9.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately elements are shifting in the clockwise direction in U-shape i.e starting with top of first column → bottom of second column → top of third column → top of first column.
 
• Alternately third column element is replaced by new element i.e 'B' is replaced by '2' and 'G' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792912460336238d6b3a56368cecfb4796e9bb203197cdefce293ae63ead497a.png] '.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14241a86c369583927e99f0cf7b2edfcde6f5207b71ee8c02eea6f6f1ceb34c6.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c3162fb3be1bfc25190b6a8da266116d506111c84d766d080bbf20247d07172.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
